display_title: A female college student who provides services
description:
Hae-Ju was an ordinary twenty-year-old—just a little more curious than most—when she entered college and ended up befriending what you might call “fast” friends. Were the adults right when they always said you have to choose your friends carefully? After that, Hae-Ju’s life starts heading in a completely different direction. It begins with her losing her virginity to her friend’s boyfriend, and from there Hae-Ju is pushed and pulled around by others. Through it all, she learns how to handle men—and becomes more honest with herself about the desire she feels. Now, she even enjoys watching men grow frantic because of her, and she starts walking down the road of true rebellion…

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
